messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1978771234 - p99 latency spike on hosted-generation (streaming). Paging oncall. Affected: generation.prod.long-context, p99 jumped from ~420ms -> ~2.8s starting 1978771200. Possible recent precision profile rollout.
meera patel: ACKing. I'm oncall. grabbing context + grabbing customer impact.
ryan choi: I'm up for triage. Oncall handover in 15. quick question: is this across regions or a single region?
alex wang: seeing the spike in us-west and eu-west. graphs show stream stalls aligning with kv-cache miss bursts and batching drops.
samir desai: we rolled int8 profile for several long-context variants 40m ago; calibration step completed. Could be calibration fallout under certain sequence distributions.
emma li: support: getting 3 customer reports for timeouts and partial streaming output, one high-visibility account experiencing repeated stalls. ISO: no data corruption reported.
ryan choi: priority: mitigate user impact. short-term options: 1) rollback precision profile to previous fp16 baseline 2) force route long-context requests to fp16 model variant 3) increase dedicated pool concurrency / autoscale. Which is lowest blast radius?
alex wang: rollback profile is low-risk and can be done quickly via model-profile rollback API. routing change is safe but needs config change in smart-router - I can push a targeted route override for long-context models.
meera patel: please do route override first to buy time. ryan -> execute route override. alex, samir: prepare rollback as next step if routing doesn't clear p99 in 10m.
ryan choi: applying route override now: `POST /admin/routing/overrides` payload -> {"model":"long-context-gen-v3","force_variant":"fp16-fallback","duration":"30m"}`
ops-bot: deploy started by ryan choi. CI job 9876.
alex wang: seeing routing change hit router nodes, traffic split shifting. monitoring p95/p99...
alex wang: p95 dropped from 580ms -> 310ms, p99 trending down from 2.8s -> 760ms. good sign.
samir desai: while routing helps, note there appears to be a specific cal profile pathology when prefix KV cache hitting 0.9 miss rate on certain token distributions, causing stalls in decoder loop during dequant. we'll still rollback if this persists.
emma li: updating customers: notifying two affected customers with workaround (route to fp16). drafting note.
meera patel: moving to mitigation -> assess root cause. alex/samir work together. ryan please prepare for handoff in 10m.
ryan choi: brief logs from one stalled stream: ```
2026-03-14T12:17:45Z ERROR streaming_worker.py:245 stall detected: kv_miss=0.93, dequant_latency=1.2s, decode_p99=2.1s
Traceback (most recent calls last):
  File "streaming_worker.py", line 230, in process_chunk
    out = dequantize_and_decode(chunk)
  File "quant_ops.cu", line 78, in dequantize
RuntimeWarning: fp8-dequant underflow?
```
alex wang: that dequant latency number aligns with our synthetic repro when calibration had edge-case scales. looks like under certain token distributions the int8/fp8 scale tables produce slow path.
samir desai: root candidate: recent calibration update that pruned out rarely-seen scale buckets; when rare sequences appear, we hit fallback code path that is not GPU-optimized and serializes across KV cache reads.
meera patel: ok plan: short-term = routing override (done), mid-term = rollback profile to previous calibration commit (samir to prepare PR/rollback), long-term = add safety gating in calibration that preserves scale buckets or ensures fast fallback. also add more synthetic tests for rare token sequences.
alex wang: initiating rollback prep: `kubectl -n models exec deploy/model-controller -- curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/rollback?profile=calib-2026-03-14-prev`
ops-bot: rollback job queued (job 9881). estimated apply in 5m after checks.
ryan choi: monitoring for customer-visible errors. emma - please escalate to CS for the one enterprise customer, include mitigation steps and ETA for rollback.
emma li: on it. messaging sent: "We're routing your long-context requests to FP16 as temporary mitigation; investigating a precision profile regression; ETA ~10-20m for rollback". customer acknowledged and tracking.
alex wang: rollback applied. model-controller reports success; profile reverted to calib-2026-03-13-stable across long-context fleet.
alex wang: metrics: p99 down to 420ms, p95 320ms. streaming stalls cleared on the main telemetry.
meera patel: marking incident as mitigated for user-facing latency. still keeping thread open to validate and do RCA.
ryan choi: oncall handoff: meera -> ryan in 10m. I'll stay as primary for postmortem until RCA complete.
samir desai: capturing repro steps and pruning commit details. will open a follow-up ticket for improved calibration gating and a canary plan for future precision-profile rollouts.
emma li: CS summary: 3 customer reports, 1 enterprise impacted for ~18m with partial streaming; we routed traffic and applied rollback; customers ok but want RCA and timeline.
meera patel: next actions: (1) samir to file RFC for calibration safety gates + canary metrics (2) alex to add faster fallback codepath for dequant (3) ryan to draft incident postmortem and SLO impact calc.
ryan choi: quick SLO calc: during window 1978771200-1978771305 we had p99 ~2.8s for 17 minutes; estimated queries above SLO ~0.6% of total traffic but weighted toward long-context heavy routes. will include numbers in postmortem.
meera patel: closing the live paging. tagging for postmortem. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident status -> mitigated. ticket 2026-INC-449 assigned to samir desai and alex wang for followups.
ryan choi: thanks everyone. I'll draft and circulate the postmortem and customer-facing RCA later today.
meera patel: ending thread — will reopen if regressions reappear. :eyes:
